PAKISTAN CANTONMENT SERVANTS
PAKISTAN CANTONMENT SERVANTS
RULES, 1954
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
29th February, 2012]
S.R.O.205(I)/2012,
dated 20-2-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (c) of
subsection (2) of section 280 of the Cantonment Act, 1924 (II of 1924), the
Federal Government is pleased to direct that the following further amendments
shall be made in the Pakistan Cantonment Servants Rules, 1954, the same having
been previously published as required by subsection (1) of that section,
namely:--
In
the aforesaid Rules,--
(1) in
rule 1, in sub-rule (1),--
(a) after
clause (a), the following new clause (aa) shall be inserted, namely:--
"(aa)
"Additional Director-General" means the Additional Director-General,
Military Lands and Cantonments Department, and includes such other officer of
the Military Lands & Cantonment Group as the Government may appoint to
exercise all or any of the
powers as such of the Additional Director-General under these rule;";
(b) clause
(e) shall be omitted;
(c) in
clause (ee), after the words "Cantonments", the words "of a
Region" shall be inserted;
(d) after
clause (ee), the following new clause (eee) shall be inserted, namely:--
"(eee) "Director-General" means the Director-General,
Military Lands and Cantonments Department, and includes such other officer as
the Government may appoint to exercise all or any of the powers of the
Director-General under these rules;";
(e) in
clause (f), after the word "Cantonment", the words "and includes
an Additional Executive Officer / Deputy Executive Officer exercising the
powers of Executive Officer in his absence" shall be inserted;
(f) after
clause (g), the following new clauses shall be inserted, namely:---
"(gg) "member of a cantonment servant's
family" includes--
(i) his
or her spouse, child or step-child, whether residing with the cantonment
servant or not; and
(ii) any
other relative of the cantonment servant or her spouse, when residing with and
wholly dependent upon the cantonment servant, but does not include a spouse
legally separated from the cantonment servant or a child or step child who is
no longer in any way dependent upon him or her or of whose custody the
cantonment servant has been deprived by law;
(ggg) "misconduct" means conduct
prejudicial to good order or service discipline or contrary to rules of
cantonment servants relating to the conduct as contained in these rules or
conduct un-becoming of an officer and a gentleman and includes any act on the
part of a cantonment servant to bring or attempt to bring political or other
outside influence directly or indirectly to bear on the Board, Government, any
Government officer or cantonment servant in respect of any matter relating to
the appointment, promotion, transfer, punishment, retirement or other
conditions of service of the cantonment servant; and includes involvement or
participation for gain either directly or indirectly in industry, trade or
speculative transactions or abuse or misuse of the official position to gain
undue advantage or assumption of financial or other obligations to private
institutions or persons such as may cause embarrassment in the performance
of official duties
or functions;''; and
(g) in
clause (j), the words figures, letters and comma "on the 28th February
1954" shall be omitted; and
(h) for
clause (k), the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"President"
means the President or Administrator of the Board appointed as such by the
Government;
(2) in
rule 3.-
(a) in
sub-rule (1), for the word "Director" the word
"Director-General" shall be substituted; and
(b) for
sub-rule (2), the following shall be substituted, namely: -
"(2) Notwithstanding
anything contained in sub-rule (1), the Revised Leave Rules, 1980 applicable to
the Civil Servants of the Federal Government shall apply mutatis mutandis to
the cantonment servants appointed under these rules.";

rule 4,-
